context_requirements: Bacterial DNA topoisomerase/gyrase or other bacterial DNA-processing enzyme must be present and essential; human cell lines lack these bacterial targets.
Bacterial infection or intracellular bacteria would be required for a pathogen-directed transcriptional response, but these are standard human cancer cell lines without bacterial infection.
falsifiers: Any reproducible concentration-dependent change in the 978 landmark genes at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine human cell lines.
Appearance of a DNA-damage transcriptional signature (e.g., CDKN1A, GADD45A, MDM2, RPA2, TP53BP1) after treatment.
Evidence of growth inhibition or apoptosis at 10 micromolar in these lines.
